canvas.clearZones: top bar above y 250, right-hand buttons x > 900 in the lower half, bottom caption/handle zone below y 1560

timing: timeline.json, measured from the full take; every beat keys on a spoken word (wordAt)

generatedOnScreen.captions: src/captions.json — the narration itself, in short cues

scenes.name: الافتتاح: دقيقتان بلا هاتف؟
scenes.purpose: the challenge in the first second: the phone is on screen from frame 0 and a timer ring draws around it
scenes.visual: phone + timer ring (red arc draws 0.3–2.9 s)
motion: ring draws from 0.3 s (no logo, no empty frame)
kinetic title word by word on «دقيقتين / بلا / هاتف»

scenes.name: حتى بلا إشعار
scenes.purpose: the reach for the phone as a loop that keeps returning, with a silent bell
scenes.visual: phone (smaller), a dotted loop, a dot that leaves and returns, tally marks, a grey bell with an empty badge
motion: loop draws as the scene opens
the dot circles every 1.2 s from «جرّب»; each return flashes the screen and adds a mark

scenes.name: لاحظ العادة
scenes.purpose: not a willpower test: noticing; the loop stops and a lens looks at the marks
scenes.visual: the dot stops (turns red) on «ليست»; a dumbbell is crossed on «بل»; a lens slides onto the marks on «ملاحظة»

scenes.name: التجربة المنشورة
scenes.purpose: the published experiment as it was: mobile internet blocked for two weeks, calls and texts kept; sustained attention improved; sticking to it was hard
scenes.visual: two weeks (14 days) fill green; wifi struck in red; call and message keep green checks; a rising green line; a small phone keeps pushing back toward the two weeks

scenes.name: تجربة، وليست وعدًا
scenes.purpose: two minutes are not the study: a long bar (two weeks) next to a tiny one (two minutes); no reset promise; then the phone is put away and a notebook takes its place
scenes.visual: bars; a reset arrow crossed; phone slides away; notebook writes

scenes.name: لسبب… أم عادة؟
scenes.purpose: the closing question as two paths from the phone, then the timer returns to the opening picture
scenes.visual: a green path to a check («لسبب») and a red loop («عادة»); the timer ring redraws around the phone; the account name
